title: Canonical finite-source quotient normalization and semilinear transition
statement:
Fix the global finite-field and coefficient datum of [def-pur-conventions], with $\ell\ne p$, finite $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$. On the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], use the completed coefficients $R_W$ and finite coefficients $B_{n,W}=(\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^{n+1})_W$, with actual quotient restrictions $\operatorname{Res}_{m,n}$ of [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower]. The index $n\in\mathbf N$ denotes exponent $n+1$. Define the direct quotient ring diagram using the actual quotient factor maps; its identity-on-sections comparison with the sequence quotient diagram induces $J_{m,n,W}:\operatorname{Res}_{m,n}\simeq\operatorname{Res}^{\mathrm{direct}}_{m,n}$ for all $n\le m$. Here direct restriction is the derived functor of exact restriction along the direct quotient ring map. For any $M\in D(R_W)$, let $L_nM$ be integral derived reduction [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction]. Define $a_{m,n,W}(M):\operatorname{red}^{\mathrm{direct}}_{m,n}L_mM\to L_nM$ as the inverse Hom-adjunction image under the finite scalar-extension/restriction adjunction [def-pur-finite-reduction-root-charts] of $t_{m,n}(M)$ followed by $J_{m,n,W}$, where $t$ is the canonical integral reduction transition [def-pur-integral-reduction-transitions].

Let $X,Y$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], $f:X\to Y$ smooth separated of pure relative dimension $d\ge0$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], and $K\in D^b_{ctf}(Y,\mathcal O_E)$ [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. Use the finite source $U_n=Lf_n^*(L_nK)(d)[2d]$ of [def-pur-adic-purity-objects], the shifted pullback functor $T_n$ of [def-pur-composition-comparisons], and the root-normalized source comparison $h_{m,n}$ of [def-pur-finite-reduction-comparisons]. Define the finite-source normalization $\rho^U_{m,n}:\operatorname{red}^{\mathrm{direct}}_{m,n}U_m\to U_n$ to be the unique arrow equal, in these actual source coordinates, to
$$h_{m,n,L_mK}\ ;\ T_n(a_{m,n,Y}(K)).$$
The normalization predicate fixes both factors and the complete composite by equality (heterogeneous equality across the displayed endpoint presentations). The displayed composite determines an existing unique arrow with these endpoints; choose that uniquely specified arrow. Define the semilinear source transition $\tau^U_{m,n}:U_m\to\operatorname{Res}_{m,n}U_n$ as the Hom-adjunction image of $\rho^U_{m,n}$ followed by $J_{m,n,X}^{-1}$. These definitions include equal indices and do not assert invertibility, finiteness, compatibility with $b^U$, or a purity theorem.

def purAdicFiniteSourceNormalization
    (K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource C.l E Y))
    (hK : finiteTorConstructibleIntegral C.l E Y K) {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) :
    ((purAdicFiniteSetting D C E m).finiteReduction (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n)
      (Nat.add_le_add_right h 1) X).obj
        (purAdicFiniteArrow D C E f d K hK m).left ⟶
      (purAdicFiniteArrow D C E f d K hK n).left
